ticket_subject: Checkout intermittently charges card twice when 3DS prompt times out
ticket_body:
Hi support,

We've had four customers email us in the past 48 hours about being charged twice on checkout. I reproduced it on my own staging account this morning.

Steps to reproduce:
1. Add any item to cart, proceed to checkout on the hosted payments page.
2. Use a card that triggers 3DS (we tested with 4000 0000 0000 3220).
3. When the 3DS modal appears, wait ~95 seconds without interacting, then approve.
4. The page shows "Payment failed, please try again" and re-enables the Pay button.
5. Click Pay a second time, complete 3DS normally.

Expected: one successful authorisation, one charge on the statement.
Actual: two authorisations land on the card. The dashboard only shows one order, but the bank statement and the Stripe-style events log both show two captures about 12 seconds apart. Error banner on first attempt reads exactly: "PSP-TIMEOUT (code 504): authorisation pending — please retry".

We are on the Pro plan. About 0.6% of our checkout volume is on cards that trigger 3DS, so this isn't catastrophic for us yet, but it's a hard blocker for the EU rollout next month because every test transaction so far has duplicated. Happy to share request IDs from our side — let me know what you need.

Thanks,
Lena (Finance Ops, Northwind)
